title: Perturb-seq Explorer
summary: Pick a gene knocked down by CRISPRi and see which other genes respond. A browser view of the K562 essential-gene Perturb-seq screen from Replogle et al. 2022, with three ways to rank the changes and a test for which ones are significant.

title: Geo Explorer
summary: A calm, no-timer geography game in English and Italian, inspired by Facebook's Geo Challenge. Learn flags, capitals, country shapes and where cities are on the map, with a daily world tour, a flag of the day and a passport to fill with stamps.
